scope: Phase query-address sensitivity and selected admission on original primary DEV histories; no model updates or new outcome gate
measurements: Per-layer routed query address cosine/difference across four query identities
Selected admission on source-quote bytes versus distractor bytes
interpretation: First phase layer sees normalized current byte embedding before its own memory outputs, so final-space address is context-free. Later layers and query-driven state writes may still enable full-model query dependence. Address similarity is not a proof of semantic binding or linear retrieval quality.
